# Three.js and presentation asset provenance

Three.js version: **0.169.0**, obtained from the official npm package `three@0.169.0`.

Package source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.169.0.tgz

Included official files:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`
- `LICENSE` (MIT; preserved)

Only the two addon import paths were changed so the modules work from this self-hosted directory without an import map or external CDN.

The scene controller `../../scene.js` is a separate implementation created for this portal. It does not copy the reference site's application logic, authentication screens or user data.

The requested reference's publicly served heraldic model was downloaded from:

https://fsbmaj.ru/assets/fsb-emblem.glb

The copied model is served as `../../assets/fsb-emblem.glb`. Its contents are a GLB 2.0 model with one mesh, three materials and two embedded images. No external texture or decoder requests are required. Its use is visual game-faction presentation, not an assertion of official government affiliation.

The procedural fallback shield, orbit rings, particles, studio reflection texture and fallback lettering are generated by code in the scene controller. All runtime modules and the model are hosted locally with the site.
